reasoning: Similar triangles give r=h/4, so V=\pi h^3/48 and dV/dt=(\pi h^2/16)(dh/dt). At h=4 with dV/dt=-\pi, dh/dt=-1 cm/min, giving a decrease rate of 1 cm/min (option d).
